upload.label: User token
help: At api.slack.com/apps, create an app from scratch in your workspace.

Under OAuth & Permissions, add these user token scopes: channels:read, groups:read, im:read, mpim:read, channels:history, groups:history, im:history, mpim:history, search:read, users:read, users:read.email, chat:write, im:write, reactions:write. Then install it (your workspace admin may need to approve it).
Copy the User OAuth Token (it starts with xoxp-) and paste it here.
